The '''subjugation of Firro''' took place prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==The subjugation==
At some point prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="Firro date" /> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] completed<ref name="GG3, 2nd" /> a ruthless subjugation of the peaceful<ref name="Fact File 1" /> [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Firro]], [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to a native<ref name="Official Starships & Vehicles 38" /> [[Alien/Legends|non-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Dagobah Limited" /> The [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]<ref name="Official Starships & Vehicles 38" /> strove for many [[Standard month/Legends|months]] to conquer the planet in a campaign that proved brutal even by the Empire's horrific standards,<ref name="Fact File 1" /> as the planet's native populace suffered many [[Death/Legends|deaths]] and atrocities.<ref name="GG3, 2nd" /><ref name="CSWE-Firro" /> Imperial participants in the subjugation of Firro included the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ardan]].<ref name="Dagobah Limited" /> Eventually, one [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cuvir]],<ref name="GG3, 2nd" /> a vicious<ref name="Official Starships & Vehicles 38" /> and draconian<ref name="2-1B Databank">{{DB|droid|tooonebee|2-1B (Too-Onebee)}}</ref> man, was proclaimed Firro's Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governor]].<ref name="GG3, 2nd" />

As a show of benevolence, the Empire provided a woefully inadequate medical team to treat<ref name="Fact File 1" /> Firro's seemingly endless flow of wounded [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]]. The medical staff, highly dedicated nonetheless,<ref name="Official Starships & Vehicles 38" /> included the [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|surgical droid]] [[2-1B/Legends|2-1B]], who worked continuously throughout the months-long subjugation<ref name="Fact File 1" /> to help Firro's countless casualties in their great pain and suffering.<ref name="GG3, 1st" /> Firro's wounded eventually began to decrease as the Empire settled in for a long [[Occupation of Firro|occupation]] of the planet.<ref name="GG3, 2nd" />
